summary: Build workforce forecasts, scenario models, and action plans with practical tools. Train your team today.
lede: Strategic workforce planning and talent scenario modelling helps you align workforce supply, skills, and roles with future business needs. You will work with demand forecasting, supply analysis, skills gap analysis, capacity planning, and scenario-based action design to connect talent decisions with operating realities. The course gives you a practical structure for analysing HRIS extracts, attrition assumptions, vacancy data, and headcount constraints. You will practise building a workforce plan, scenario workbook, and KPI scorecard that support evidence-based decisions across HR, finance, and operations.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who need to connect workforce supply, future demand, and business strategy in practical planning cycles.
prerequisites: You should have an intermediate working knowledge of HR operations, headcount reporting, and basic workforce planning concepts. Familiarity with spreadsheets and HRIS reports is required, but no programming is required. Experience with budgeting, resourcing, or talent analytics will help you move faster through the scenario modelling exercises. Advanced concepts such as scenario logic and workforce risk modelling are taught at the operational application level, not at technical engineering depth.
